title.rendered: Top IB Schools In Dubai 2026: Ratings & Fees

content.rendered:
Key Summary

  • 30+ IB World Schools In Dubai: Dubai has over 30 IB authorised schools, with around 20 offering the full PYP-MYP-DP continuum.
  • 5 KHDA Outstanding-Rated IB Schools: Dubai International Academy, JESS Arabian Ranches, GEMS Dubai American Academy, GEMS Modern Academy, and Repton School Dubai hold the highest KHDA rating.
  • Wide Fee Range: Annual tuition runs from AED 33,544 at Raffles World Academy to AED 137,736 at premium institutions, giving families real choice across budgets.
  • Strong IB Outcomes: Dubai’s average IB Diploma score sits at 33-34 points against the global average of 30. JESS Arabian Ranches leads with 38 points; DIA averages 36.2; NLCS Dubai exceeds 36.
  • Choosing The Right Fit: Match school choice to your child’s age, KHDA rating, fee fit, university destination, and whether you want full IB continuum or hybrid British/American IB pathways.

Dubai is one of the largest IB markets in the Middle East, with over 30 IB World Schools authorised by the International Baccalaureate Organisation. The challenge for parents is not finding an IB school but choosing between them.

This guide covers the top 15 IB schools in Dubai for 2026 with verified KHDA ratings, current fees, 2024-25 IB Diploma results, and the practical details families need to shortlist properly. 

At Ignite Training Institute, we work with IB students across Dubai through our IB curriculum tutors, so we see how school choice plays out in real student outcomes year after year.

How Many IB Schools Are In Dubai?

Dubai has over 30 IB World Schools authorised by the International Baccalaureate Organisation, with around 20 offering the full IB continuum (PYP, MYP, and DP). Five hold the KHDA Outstanding rating: Dubai International Academy, JESS Arabian Ranches, GEMS Dubai American Academy, GEMS Modern Academy, and Repton School Dubai. Annual fees range from AED 33,544 at Raffles World Academy to over AED 137,000 at premium institutions. The average IB Diploma score in Dubai is approximately 33-34 points, well above the global average of 30.

Know More About: IB Diploma Programme Explained: A Complete 2025 Guide

What Are The Top 15 IB Schools In Dubai?

The table below summarises the leading IB schools in Dubai based on KHDA ratings, programmes offered, and fees. Ratings reflect the most recent published inspection cycles. Fees are indicative annual figures for the 2025-26 academic year and may vary by year group.

1. Dubai International Academy (DIA), Emirates Hills

Image Source: Google My Business – www.diadubai.com

DIA is Dubai’s only all-through IB continuum school holding the KHDA Outstanding rating. Established in 2005 in Emirates Hills, the school serves students from KG1 to Grade 12 across the full PYP, MYP, and DP programmes. The 2025 cohort averaged 36.2 IB points against the global average of 30, with two students achieving the maximum 45 points.

The school enrolls students from over 85 nationalities. Annual fees range from AED 56,000 to AED 99,000. DIA was the inaugural IB school granted authorization in the UAE and the first to attain KHDA Outstanding status for IB. Admissions are competitive across all year groups and applications typically open 12 months ahead of intake. Recent graduates have secured places at Harvard, Stanford, Oxford, Cambridge, and LSE, with a strong track record of Russell Group and Ivy League acceptances.

2. JESS Arabian Ranches

Image Source: Google My Business – www.jess.sch.ae

JESS Arabian Ranches is rated Outstanding by KHDA and delivers the highest IB Diploma average in Dubai, achieving 38 points in recent cohorts. The school follows the British curriculum from FS1 through Year 11 (IGCSE) and offers the IB Diploma alongside A Levels at Sixth Form, giving students a meaningful choice at Year 12.

Annual fees run from AED 60,000 to AED 90,000. The school enrolls over 1,400 students from 60+ nationalities with a teacher-to-student ratio of approximately 1:12. JESS is part of the JESS family (alongside JESS Jumeirah) and has held Outstanding for multiple consecutive inspection cycles. The school’s ability to deliver British curriculum through Year 11 then a 38-point IB Diploma average at Sixth Form is unmatched in Dubai, making it the strongest hybrid pathway for academic high-achievers.

3. GEMS Dubai American Academy

Image Source: Google My Business – www.gemsaa-dubai.com

GEMS Dubai American Academy is the only US curriculum school in Dubai with KHDA Outstanding for 11 consecutive inspections. It delivers the American curriculum alongside Advanced Placement (AP) courses and the IB Diploma, giving senior students three pathways: US Diploma, AP, or IBDP.

Annual fees range from AED 66,185 to AED 93,300. The school operates in Al Barsha and serves around 3,088 students. With 12 guidance counsellors and 34 elective courses, it has one of the strongest college preparation infrastructures in the city. The dual American-IB pathway is particularly valuable for families uncertain between US college (where AP/SAT matters most) and global universities (where IB scores matter most).

4. GEMS Modern Academy

Image Source: www.gemsmodernacademy-dubai.com

GEMS Modern Academy is the only Indian curriculum school in Dubai rated KHDA Outstanding, holding the rating since 2012. The school follows the CISCE curriculum to Grade 12 with the IB Diploma offered as an alternative pathway in Grades 11 and 12.

Annual fees range from AED 41,000 to AED 68,000, making it one of the most affordable Outstanding-rated IB schools. Founded in 1986, the school is co-educational and enrols students from KG to Grade 12. Admissions begin from Pre-KG and are granted via entrance assessment. For Indian families wanting CISCE rigour with an IB Diploma option at Sixth Form, GEMS Modern Academy is effectively unmatched in Dubai at this price point.

5. Repton School Dubai

Image Source: Google My Business – www.reptondubai.org

Repton School Dubai is part of the Repton family of schools and holds KHDA Outstanding. The school follows the British curriculum from FS1 through Year 11, then offers both A Levels and the IB Diploma at Sixth Form. Located in Nad Al Sheba, the campus is modelled on its UK parent school and includes boarding facilities.

Annual fees run from AED 80,000 to AED 120,000. Repton has consistently delivered strong A Level and IB results, and Cognita’s global network gives students access to exchange opportunities across 90+ schools in 21 countries. Repton’s boarding option is rare in Dubai’s day-school landscape and appeals to families who travel frequently or live further from premium school clusters.

6. NLCS Dubai (North London Collegiate)

Image Source: Google My Business – www.nlcsdubai.ae

NLCS Dubai is the Dubai branch of the historic North London Collegiate School. The school is rated KHDA Very Good and is exclusively IB, with every student following the IB pathway from primary through to the Diploma. The 2024-25 IB Diploma cohort averaged 36+ points, well above the Dubai average.

Annual fees range from AED 75,000 to AED 137,736, making NLCS one of the highest-fee IB schools in Dubai. The school opened in 2017 in Al Furjan and serves students from Pre-KG to Grade 12. NLCS is one of the few schools in Dubai where every student follows the IB pathway with no British or American alternative, which makes the academic culture distinctly IB-focused throughout.

7. SISD (Swiss International Scientific School Dubai)

Image Source: www.nordangliaeducation.com/sisd-dubai/campus

SISD is Dubai’s only bilingual IB school, offering instruction in English alongside French, German, or Arabic. The school is rated KHDA Very Good and delivers the full IB continuum from PYP through DP. In 2025, 60% of SISD graduates earned bilingual IB Diplomas, a meaningful distinction for university applications.

Annual fees range from AED 65,000 to AED 117,000. The 2024-25 IB Diploma average was 33.2 points. The eco-campus in Al Jaddaf includes boarding facilities and serves students from over 100 nationalities. The bilingual diploma is a meaningful differentiator for European university applications, particularly for French Grandes Écoles and German universities that value native-level language proficiency.

8. GEMS World Academy

Image Source: Google My Business – www.gemsworldacademy-dubai.com/en

GEMS World Academy in Al Barsha South delivers the full IB continuum (PYP, MYP, DP) plus the Career-related Programme (CP). KHDA rates the school Very Good. In 2025, GEMS World Academy achieved an average IB score above 35 points with a 95%+ pass rate. The school is triple-accredited by IBO, CIS, and NEASC.

Annual fees range from AED 65,747 to AED 114,128. The campus features a 400-metre athletics track, Olympic-sized pool, 620-seat auditorium, recording studio, and a 3D planetarium. Class sizes average 22-24 with a maximum of 25 from PYP up. GEMS World Academy is one of the few Dubai IB schools to offer the Career-related Programme (CP) alongside the Diploma, giving students with vocational interests an academically rigorous alternative.

9. Dwight School Dubai

Image Source: https://dwight.ae/visit/

Dwight School Dubai is the Dubai branch of Dwight School New York, the first school in the Americas authorised to offer the full IB continuum. The Dubai campus opened in 2018 in Jumeirah Park and operates under direct management from Dwight New York. KHDA rates the school Very Good.

Annual fees range from AED 60,000 to AED 95,000. The school is intentionally smaller than most Dubai IB schools, which gives students more individual attention. All four IB programmes (PYP, MYP, DP, CP) are offered. Dwight’s “Personalised Learning Community” approach and the Spark Tank entrepreneurship programme are unique features that suit students with creative or independent learning styles.

10. Greenfield International School

Image Source: Google My Business – www.gischool.ae

Greenfield International School is one of the more affordable full-IB-continuum schools in Dubai. Operated by Taaleem in Dubai Investments Park, the school is rated KHDA Very Good and offers all four IB programmes from Pre-KG to Grade 12. The 2024-25 IB Diploma cohort averaged 33 points.

Annual fees range from AED 38,000 to AED 70,000. Greenfield serves over 75 nationalities and has built a reputation for strong multilingual provision and the ACE enrichment programme alongside the standard IB curriculum. For families wanting full IB continuum delivery without premium pricing, Greenfield is one of the few options in Dubai that delivers all four IB programmes (PYP, MYP, DP, and CP) at this fee level.

11. Raffles World Academy

Image Source: Google My Business – www.rwadubai.com

Raffles World Academy is the most affordable KHDA Very Good-rated full-IB school in Dubai, with Pre-Primary fees starting at AED 33,544. Operated by Innoventures Education, the school offers the full PYP, MYP, and DP continuum from Pre-Primary to Grade 12.

Annual fees range from AED 33,544 to AED 93,922. The school is in Umm Suqeim 3 and achieved Outstanding scores across its Personal and Social Development indicators in the 2023-24 DSIB inspection. Over 1,800 students from 80+ nationalities attend. Raffles offers genuine value for families starting in early years, with Pre-Primary fees often half what comparable Very Good-rated schools charge in the same Jumeirah corridor.

12. Sunmarke School

Image Source: Google My Business – www.sunmarke.com

Sunmarke School in Jumeirah Village Triangle is rated KHDA Very Good and delivers the British curriculum from FS1 through Year 11, then offers the IB Diploma as an alternative pathway at Sixth Form. The school is part of the Fortes Education group.

Annual fees range from AED 50,000 to AED 85,000. Sunmarke is known for its positive education framework and parent-rated pastoral care. The IB Diploma cohort has consistently achieved averages above the global benchmark of 30 points. The school is one of the more affordable hybrid British-IB pathways in Dubai, sitting well below JESS or Repton on fees while still offering both A Levels and IB Diploma at Sixth Form.

13. Jumeira Baccalaureate School

Image Source: Google My Business – www.jbschool.ae

Jumeira Baccalaureate School (JBS), located in Jumeirah 1, specializes in offering the IB Diploma program at the senior level. The school is rated KHDA Very Good and accepts students from Pre-KG to Grade 12, with the full IB pathway as the primary academic offering.

Annual fees range from AED 70,000 to AED 95,000. JBS is part of the Taaleem group and has maintained consistent IB results over the past decade. The school’s compact size keeps year groups smaller than larger institutions. JBS is a strong fit for families committed to the IB Diploma at Sixth Form who want a focused IB-only academic culture without the pressure of larger continuum schools.

14. Uptown International School

Image Source: Google My Business – www.uischool.ae

Uptown International School in Mirdif was among the first IB curriculum schools to open in Dubai. Owned and operated by Taaleem, the school is rated KHDA Good and offers the full IB continuum (PYP, MYP, DP). The location near the Sharjah border makes it convenient for families across the eastern Dubai-Sharjah corridor.

Annual fees range from AED 45,000 to AED 85,000. Uptown serves families looking for established IB provision at mid-tier fees, with strong community ties and lower transport costs than premium-area schools. Having opened over two decades ago, Uptown has one of the longest IB delivery histories in Dubai, which translates into well-established Internal Assessment standards and Extended Essay supervision.

15. Dar Al Marefa Private School

Image Source: Google My Business – www.daralmarefa.ae/en/home

Dar Al Marefa Private School in Mirdif is one of two bilingual English-Arabic IB schools in Dubai (alongside SISD’s bilingual French/German/Arabic option). The school is rated KHDA Good and offers the full IB continuum from PYP through DP.

Annual fees range from AED 40,000 to AED 65,000. The bilingual provision is particularly relevant for Emirati families and Arabic-speaking expats who want their children to maintain Arabic literacy alongside English instruction. G

raduates often enter UAE universities with stronger Arabic proficiency than peers from English-only IB schools, which opens scholarship and admission pathways at institutions like UAEU and Khalifa University.

IB Schools In Dubai By Fees

Understanding where each school sits on the fee spectrum helps families shortlist quickly. Fee bands below are based on 2025-26 published tuition before transport, uniforms, examination fees, and capital fees.

Affordable Tier (AED 33,000 To AED 50,000)

The most accessible IB schools in Dubai sit in this band. 

  • Raffles World Academy starts at AED 33,544 in Pre-Primary and is the most affordable Very Good-rated full-IB school. 
  • Greenfield International School (AED 38,000 to AED 70,000) 
  • Dar Al Marefa (AED 40,000 to AED 65,000) also cover this tier
  • GEMS Modern Academy starts at AED 41,000, making it the most affordable Outstanding-rated IB school in Dubai.

Mid Tier (AED 50,000 To AED 80,000)

The mid tier covers 

  • Sunmarke School (AED 50,000-85,000)
  • Uptown International (AED 45,000-85,000)
  • Dwight Dubai (AED 60,000-95,000)
  • JESS Arabian Ranches (AED 60,000-90,000) at the lower year groups. 

SISD and GEMS World Academy cross into this band at primary years. This tier offers credible IB outcomes at fees most professional families can absorb.

Premium Tier (AED 80,000 To AED 110,000)

The premium tier includes 

  • GEMS Dubai American Academy (AED 66,185-93,300)
  • GEMS World Academy (AED 65,747-114,128)
  • DIA (AED 56,000-99,000) at senior years
  • Jumeira Baccalaureate School and Repton at lower year groups also sit here. 

This is where Outstanding-rated provision meets Sixth Form fees.

Top Tier (AED 110,000 To AED 138,000)

  • NLCS Dubai (AED 75,000-137,736) and Repton Dubai (AED 80,000-120,000) at senior years sit firmly within this band. 
  • SISD (up to AED 117,000) and GEMS World Academy (up to AED 114,128) cross into this band at Diploma years. 

These schools deliver world-class facilities, low teacher-to-student ratios, and IB results that match top international schools globally.

How To Choose The Right IB School In Dubai?

School choice often comes down to brand recognition or fee tier. Here is what genuinely matters when comparing IB schools.

1. Understanding KHDA Ratings (And IB Score Data)

KHDA inspects every private school in Dubai and publishes ratings on a six-point scale: Outstanding, Very Good, Good, Acceptable, Weak, Very Weak. The rating affects how much a school can raise fees each year, which is a real practical consequence beyond educational quality.

  • KHDA paused full inspections for 2024-25 and 2025-26, so ratings reflect the 2023-24 cycle for most schools
  • For IB schools specifically, also check the school’s published average IB Diploma score (Dubai average is 33-34 points; global average is 30)
  • A school rated Very Good can outperform an Outstanding-rated school on IB results (NLCS Dubai and Sunmarke are good examples)
  • Always check both the KHDA rating and 3-year IB results before deciding

2. Real Total Cost (Beyond Published Fees)

Published tuition is rarely the full picture. Add 15-25% to the listed annual fee for a realistic full cost.

  • Registration fee: 5% of annual tuition, adjustable against first term
  • IB exam fees: USD 200-220 per subject for Diploma registration plus candidate fee
  • Transport: AED 5,841 to AED 12,000 annually depending on distance
  • Uniforms: AED 3,000 to AED 6,000 in the first year at premium schools
  • CAS-related costs: Expeditions and projects can add AED 5,000-15,000 over the two-year DP

3. Continuum Vs Diploma-Only

Continuum schools (PYP-MYP-DP) suit families starting in early years. Children who experience PYP’s inquiry-based approach adapt more easily to MYP and the rigour of the IB Diploma later.

For students commencing at the senior level (Year 12), a robust IBDP-exclusive institution operating in conjunction with an alternative curriculum can be just as effective. What matters more is the quality of IBDP delivery in the final two years and the school’s published average IB scores and university destinations.

IB Tutoring For Dubai Students With Ignite Training Institute

The truth about the IB Diploma is that it humbles even the strongest students in the first term of Year 12. Six subjects, three Internal Assessments, the Extended Essay, TOK, and 150 hours of CAS hit at once, and even students who breezed through MYP or IGCSE suddenly find themselves drowning in deadlines. 

That is where focused tutoring genuinely changes outcomes. The difference between a 5 and a 7 in HL Maths, Physics, or Chemistry is rarely about ability. It is about how well the student understands command terms, mark scheme expectations, and the specific way IB examiners want answers structured. A good tutor closes that gap in weeks, not months.

At Ignite, our IBDP tutors and MYP tutors work with students from every IB school in this guide. Subject-specific support spans for Maths, Physics, Chemistry, Biology, Economics, English, & other core subjects with tutors who know the IB rubrics inside out. 

If your child is starting Grade 11 next September, mid-IBDP and slipping behind, or aiming to push from a 4 to a 6 in a key subject before exams, book a free demo class. We will match them with the right tutor, and the first session is on us.

FAQs

1. Which Is The Best IB School In Dubai?

By KHDA rating and IB Diploma results, JESS Arabian Ranches leads with a 38-point average and Outstanding rating. With a full IB continuum at an Outstanding rating, Dubai International Academy is the clear choice. By affordability at strong outcomes, GEMS Modern Academy or Greenfield International School. The “best” depends on your child’s age, curriculum preference, and budget.

2. How Much Does IB School Cost In Dubai?

Annual tuition ranges from AED 33,544 at Raffles World Academy to AED 137,736 at NLCS Dubai. Most families budget AED 50,000-90,000 per year for an established Very Good or Outstanding-rated IB school, plus 15-25% for transport, uniforms, examination fees, and capital fees.

3. How Is IB Different From CBSE Or British Curriculum?

The IB requires six subjects across six groups plus three core components (TOK, Extended Essay, CAS). CBSE follows Classes 1-12 with board exams at Class 10 and 12. The British curriculum uses IGCSE at Year 11 and A Levels at Year 13 with three to four specialised subjects. IB favours breadth and global mobility; CBSE and British favour subject specialisation.

4. Which IB School In Dubai Has The Highest IB Diploma Score?

JESS Arabian Ranches leads the city with a 38-point average. Dubai International Academy averages 36.2 points, NLCS Dubai exceeds 36, and GEMS World Academy averages 35+. SISD averages 33.2, with 60% of students earning bilingual diplomas.

5. Are There Affordable IB Schools In Dubai?

Yes. Raffles World Academy (from AED 33,544), Greenfield International School (AED 38,000-70,000), Dar Al Marefa (AED 40,000-65,000), and GEMS Modern Academy (AED 41,000-68,000) all deliver authorised IB programmes at lower fees than premium IB schools. GEMS Modern Academy is the most affordable Outstanding-rated IB option.

6. What Does An IB School Mean?

An IB school is one authorised by the International Baccalaureate Organisation in Switzerland to deliver one or more of four IB programmes: PYP (ages 3-12), MYP (ages 11-16), DP (ages 16-19), or CP (career-related, ages 16-19). Authorisation requires teacher training, assessment standards, and ongoing IBO review.

Conclusion

Dubai’s IB landscape is mature and competitive, with options across every fee bracket and rating tier. The right school depends on continuum vs diploma-only preference, KHDA rating, fee fit, and university targets. Use the comparison table above to shortlist three to four schools, verify the latest KHDA reports, request the school’s three-year IB results, and tour campuses before deciding.

If your child needs academic support to make their IB scores match their potential, reach out to Ignite’s team, and we will put together a plan.
